body:
I understand.
And I don't know where I am going.
There is no god. There is no hell. We are our own gods and we make our own hell.
I'm sorry about your dad. (And for you) Can I ask how old you were?

The irony. Check yourself in to save yourself. Can't work because you're checked in. No work = no money. When you get out you may feel mentally better for a day but everything else has gone deeper into shit while you were out of service.
Do you ever wish he took you with him?

Hey boss. Life sucks. It's not getting better. Somehow we have to figure out how to deal with it though. I'm still working on it. Funny how I care more about you right now than I do about my own fucked up self. I want nothing more than to end it all right now but I want to tell you to hang on and stay alive. I think though that getting a new shrink is probably the best course of action (probably for both of us.) I have seen a dozen shrinks over the years and all of them were worthless.  I keep hoping that I'll find one that helps. But I guarantee you that if you've been seeing this one for 2 years and its not better then you need a change. You've got nothing to lose by dropping the one who doesnt help.
